# Security KG Viz — AI agent guide

Fully static React 19 + Vite 6 + TypeScript (strict) SPA that visualizes a 26M+ triple security knowledge graph (24 sources, aggregated from the upstream [`security-kg`](https://github.com/S0UGATA/security-kg) project) by running **DuckDB-WASM in the browser** against a remote Parquet file on HuggingFace (HTTP range requests, no backend). Rendering uses **3d-force-graph** ([src/components/GraphView.tsx](../src/components/GraphView.tsx) wraps `ForceGraph3D` + `three`).

## Architecture (read these together)

- [src/lib/duckdb.ts](../src/lib/duckdb.ts) — **singleton** `AsyncDuckDBConnection` lazily created by `getConnection()`. `buildKgViewSql(source)` is the single source of truth for the `kg` view, accepting either a single URL (`parquet_scan`) or a list of URLs (`read_parquet([...], union_by_name=true)` for partitioned mode). The view emits an extra `object_canonical` column (`lower(trim(object))` for literal rows, identity for id rows) so graph-builder / SqlConsole share one canonical form. All data access goes through helpers here:
  - `queryEntity`, `queryEntityMultiHop(id, depth, limit, 'bfs'|'dfs')`, `querySQL`, `setParquetUrl(url: string | string[])` (mutex-guarded, rolls back to previous source on failure), `getCurrentParquetUrl` / `getCurrentParquetSource`.
  - Status changes broadcast via `onStatusChange` listener (`'idle' | 'loading-wasm' | 'loading-parquet' | 'ready' | 'error'`) — consumed by [src/App.tsx](../src/App.tsx) header indicator. Cache invalidation broadcast via `onKgChanged` — consumed by [src/lib/queries.ts](../src/lib/queries.ts).
  - Multi-hop traversal is a per-hop fetch loop (`traverseBFS` / `traverseDFS`) that caps each hop's SQL `LIMIT` at the remaining triple budget. We tried a single `WITH RECURSIVE` CTE once — it hung on hub entities (e.g. `T1059`) because nothing bounded the per-iteration fan-out before the outer `LIMIT` applied.
  - The `kg` schema is `subject, predicate, object, source, object_type, meta, object_canonical` (all string). `object_type !== 'id'` means a literal; `meta` is a per-triple JSON string from the upstream converters and is kept in the view for SqlConsole ad-hoc queries, but the high-volume helpers (`queryEntity`, `fetchNeighbors`) deliberately omit it from their SELECTs — nothing in the UI renders it and parquet is columnar, so skipping it saves bytes on every traversal query.
- [src/lib/queries.ts](../src/lib/queries.ts) — **named-queries module + cache**, the single seam every view uses for SQL aggregations. Exports `q.summary()`, `q.topPredicates(n)`, `q.countBySource()`, `q.crossSourceLinks({limit, includePredicate})`, `q.topConnectedEntities(n)`, `q.entityNeighborhood(id, depth, limit, mode)`, plus `fetchPrecomputedStats()` for the HF stats-JSON fast path. Results are cached in-memory (5-min TTL, shared in-flight promises) and the cache clears via `onKgChanged` on source switch. **Never write raw SQL aggregations in a component — add a named query here.**
- [src/lib/useQuery.ts](../src/lib/useQuery.ts) — single `useQuery(fn, deps, { enabled? })` hook with a generation counter that discards stale results. Use this for any new deps-driven async view; do not reinvent `cancelled` flags.
- [src/lib/constants.ts](../src/lib/constants.ts) — single source of truth for the **curated 24-hue source palette** (`SOURCE_COLORS`), display names (`SOURCE_LABELS`), `detectSource(id)` regex heuristics, `AVAILABLE_PARQUET_FILES`, URL builders `parquetFileUrl` / `statsFileUrl`, plus `PARTITIONED_FILE_TOKEN` + `PARTITIONED_PARQUET_URLS` for the "Partitioned (per-source union)" mode. Add new sources here first.
- [src/lib/graph-builder.ts](../src/lib/graph-builder.ts) — pure `Triple[] → GraphData` transform. The literal-merge key comes from the SQL view's `object_canonical` column (with a JS lowercase fallback), so graph-builder no longer owns the canonicalisation rule. Predicate→color uses a cached string-hash → HSL; the `centerEntity` node is enlarged and flagged `isCenter`. `GraphLink` carries `predicate` and `triplesSource`; `buildLinkLabel` renders `predicate [source]` into the hover tooltip.
- [src/App.tsx](../src/App.tsx) — tabbed shell. **Switching the parquet source bumps `sourceKey`, which is part of each tab's `key=` to force-remount and discard cached state.** When adding a tab that holds query state, follow this pattern. The four heavy tabs (Dashboard, SourceMap, EntityExplorer, SqlConsole) are loaded via `React.lazy()` so the cold-start bundle excludes Three.js / 3d-force-graph / Chart.js. On mount the shell also prewarms `getConnection()` so DuckDB-WASM downloads in parallel with the UI render and the default-tab chunk fetch.
- [src/components/ErrorBoundary.tsx](../src/components/ErrorBoundary.tsx) — class component with optional `fallback(error, reset)` render-prop. Each tab in `App.tsx` is wrapped so one view crashing doesn't blank the page. EntityExplorer wraps `GraphView` in a nested boundary whose fallback is [src/components/TripleTable.tsx](../src/components/TripleTable.tsx) — if 3d-force-graph / WebGL dies, users still see the underlying triples as a table.
- [src/components/GraphView.tsx](../src/components/GraphView.tsx) — imperative wrapper around `ForceGraph3D`. **Critical pattern:** every `THREE` geometry/material/texture must be tracked in `disposablesRef` / `sharedSpheresRef` / `sharedMaterialsRef` and released in `cleanupAll()` (called on unmount and before re-rendering new data). Shared geometry/material caches keyed by rounded size/color avoid per-node allocation. Use refs (`onNodeClickRef`, `labelModeRef`, `optionsRef`) for callbacks/props that the imperative engine reads during animation frames. Accepts a `viewOptions` prop and exposes a `GraphViewHandle` ref (`fit()` / `togglePause()`); most options apply live via small effects + `refresh()`, only `layout` triggers a rebuild. Bloom is lazy-loaded from `three/addons/postprocessing` so it stays out of the cold-start bundle.
- [src/lib/viewOptions.ts](../src/lib/viewOptions.ts) — `ViewOptions` type + `useViewOptions()` hook persisted to localStorage under `security-kg-viz:view-options:v1`. Defaults via `DEFAULT_VIEW_OPTIONS` so adding a new field is non-breaking.
- [src/components/GraphSettings.tsx](../src/components/GraphSettings.tsx) — floating gear panel rendered top-left inside `.graph-container`. Hosts Fit/Pause buttons, display toggles (auto-rotate, hover-highlight, particles, bloom), layout selector (force/radial/top-down), label-mode selector, and charge/link-distance sliders.
- [src/components/Dashboard.tsx](../src/components/Dashboard.tsx) — tries `statsFileUrl(getCurrentParquetUrl())` first (instant, pre-computed), falls back to phased live DuckDB queries on 404. Chart.js modules are explicitly `ChartJS.register(...)`'d at module top.

## Conventions & gotchas

- **Strict TS, no unused locals/params, no implicit any.** `tsc -b` runs in `npm run build`; keep the build green.
- SQL in `duckdb.ts` is built via string interpolation but sanitized: IDs escape `'` → `''`, limits go through `sanitizeLimit` (1–100000). Preserve this when adding queries — never concat raw user input.
- The `SqlConsole` tab exposes raw SQL via `querySQL` (read-only since the parquet view is immutable); example queries live in `EXAMPLE_QUERIES` in [src/lib/constants.ts](../src/lib/constants.ts).
- Entity-explorer search runs multi-hop (`depth=10`, default limit 500) with BFS or DFS — see [src/components/EntityExplorer.tsx](../src/components/EntityExplorer.tsx). It uses a `searchGenRef` generation counter to discard stale async results and calls `q.entityNeighborhood(...)` so repeats hit the cache. For any new deps-driven async view, prefer `useQuery` from [src/lib/useQuery.ts](../src/lib/useQuery.ts) over rolling a `cancelled` flag.
- Vite config: `optimizeDeps.exclude: ['@duckdb/duckdb-wasm']` (required — duckdb pulls its own workers from jsDelivr at runtime via `getJsDelivrBundles()`), and `manualChunks` split out `three`, `3d-force-graph`, `chartjs`, `react`. `base` comes from `VITE_BASE_PATH` env (set in CI to `/<repo-name>/`).

## Workflows

- `npm run dev` — Vite dev server. First query takes seconds (WASM + parquet metadata download).
- `npm run build` — `tsc -b && vite build`. `npm run typecheck` for type-only check.
- Deployment: [.github/workflows/deploy.yml](workflows/deploy.yml) builds with `VITE_BASE_PATH=/<repo>/` and publishes `dist/` to GitHub Pages on push to `main`.
- **Stats are generated elsewhere** — pre-computed `stats/<name>.stats.json` files live in the upstream [`s0u9ata/security-kg`](https://huggingface.co/datasets/s0u9ata/security-kg) HF dataset repo. Do **not** add a stats-generation script or CI job here; [src/components/Dashboard.tsx](../src/components/Dashboard.tsx) just fetches them via `statsFileUrl(...)` with a live-DuckDB fallback.
- **Keep [README.md](../README.md) and [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md) in sync with code changes.** When you change architecture, dependencies, views, project structure, the deploy workflow, or add/remove a data source, update the matching sections in this file, README.md, and CLAUDE.md in the same change.
- No test suite is configured.

## When adding a new data source

1. Add color (pick a hue that's clearly distinct from existing sources in the same family) + label + (optionally) `detectSource` regex in [src/lib/constants.ts](../src/lib/constants.ts).
2. Add a parquet file entry to `AVAILABLE_PARQUET_FILES` so `DataSourceSelector` picks it up.
3. If the source needs an edge in the Source Map, add it to `KNOWN_LINKS` in [src/lib/graph-builder.ts](../src/lib/graph-builder.ts).
4. Update the sources table in [README.md](../README.md) and [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md).
